summary.text: Steve Simon is the DFL Secretary of State of Minnesota and won a fourth term on November 3, 2026, according to unofficial results.

A former state representative who chaired the House elections committee, he has overseen Minnesota's elections since 2015 and has opposed a Justice Department demand for the state's voter registration data.

paragraphs.text: He served in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2005 to 2014, including as chair of its Elections Committee, before becoming secretary of state in January 2015.
According to his candidate questionnaire, Simon wrote the law allowing eligible Minnesotans to vote from home.
KAXE's editor's note says Minnesota ranked first in MIT's Elections Performance Index for 2024.

He won the November 3, 2026 general election for Secretary of State of Minnesota with 54.7% of the vote to Tad Jude's 41.8% and George Tangen's 2.0% and 1 other candidate, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
